description: This file defines a mock class 'ServerMock' for the 'IServer' interface used in IPC (Inter-Process Communication) testing within the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing server behaviors such as adding sockets and clients, and processing events.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IServer interface for testing IPC server interactions.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Mocks adding a socket with a specified path and connection callbacks.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Mocks adding a client with a socket file descriptor and disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the file descriptor associated with the server.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Mocks waiting for events with a specified timeout.
